READING_COMPREHENSION.category: Good and Bad Habits - Cause and Effect
READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Sofia has three bad habits on school nights. She uses her phone in bed, goes to sleep very late and sometimes skips breakfast the next morning. Then she feels tired in class and gets hungry before lunch. This week she wants to change. She puts her phone on the desk, goes to bed earlier and has breakfast every morning.

questions.q: Why is Sofia tired in class?
questions.a: She goes to sleep very late
options: She goes to sleep very late

questions.q: Why does Sofia get hungry before lunch?
Where does Sofia put her phone now?
What good habit she start?
options: She eats fast food every day

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Nico gets up at half past six. He has a shower at a quarter to seven and gets dressed at seven. He goes to school at half past seven. He has lunch at twelve o'clock and gets home at four. Then he does his homework. He goes to bed at half past nine.

questions.q: What does Nico do at a quarter to seven?
What time does he go to school?
What does he do after he gets home?
What time does he go to bed?

READING_COMPREHENSION.category: Present Simple - My Brother and I
READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: I'm Nora and I'm very different from my brother, Max. I read comics, but Max reads adventure books. I listen to pop music and he listens to rock. I walk to school, but Max goes by bike. After school, I meet my friends. Max plays computer games. I do my homework after dinner, but Max studies before dinner. We have dinner together at eight o'clock.

questions.q: What does Max read?
How does Max go to school?
What does Nora do after school?
Do Nora and Max have dinner together?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Ashley is new at the robotics club. The club meets on Mondays at half past three. There is a competition on Saturday. Mina says the team often has problems, but they always have fun. On Friday, Mina tells everyone to go to bed early and have a big breakfast. Theo says he is rarely late. After the competition, the team celebrates together.

questions.q: When does the robotics club meet?
questions.a: On Mondays at half past three
options: On Mondays at half past three

questions.q: When is the competition?
Does the team often have problems?
What does Mina tell the team to do on Friday?
questions.a: Go to bed early and have a big breakfast
options: Go to bed early and have a big breakfast

questions.q: Is Theo usually late?

READING_COMPREHENSION.category: Adverbs of Frequency - My Difficult Monday
READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Monday is a difficult day for me. On Sunday evening, I usually have tennis practice, so on Monday I sometimes get up late. My dad always prepares breakfast, but I rarely eat much because I'm in a hurry. School starts at half past eight and finishes in the afternoon. I never watch TV at night on Mondays because I'm very tired.

questions.q: When does the writer usually have tennis practice?
Does the writer sometimes get up late on Monday?
Who always prepares breakfast?
Does the writer often watch TV at night on Mondays?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Ethan has got a big bedroom next to the bathroom. He's got a bed, a wardrobe for his clothes and a bookcase. There is a desk in his room, too. Ethan always does his homework at his desk. He plays on his tablet and reads on his bed. There is a big window above the bed. His little sister is seven years old and she usually goes to bed early.

questions.q: What is next to Ethan's bedroom?
Where does Ethan do his homework?
What does Ethan play on?
What is above the bed?
How old is Ethan's sister?

READING_COMPREHENSION.readingText: Lucia is an exchange student at Bec's school in England. They arrive at 7:30 because Bec's mum starts work early, so they eat at the school breakfast club. Lessons start at 9:00 and school finishes at 3:30. Lessons are 45 minutes long. A bell tells students when to change classrooms, and each subject has its own classroom. The school has rules about talking in the corridor, eating snacks in classrooms and school clothes. Students wear black uniforms. Bec's school has about 1,100 students. The UK school year starts in September and finishes at the end of July, with several holidays during the year.

questions.q: Why do Lucia and Bec arrive at school at 7:30?
questions.a: Because Bec's mum starts work early
options: Because Bec's mum starts work early

questions.q: What time do lessons start?
How long is each lesson?
What tells students to change classrooms?
Can students have snacks in the classroom?
Do students wear a uniform?
When does the UK school year start?
